map.由声强求声强级（I₀=10⁻¹² W/m²）: Intensity level from sound intensity (I0=10^-12 W/m2)
map.输入声强，求声强级。: Enter the sound intensity to get the intensity level.
map.📖 查看「由声强求声强级（I₀=10⁻¹² W/m²） 使用指南」: 📖 View Guide: "Intensity level from sound intensity (I0=10^-12 W/m2)"
map.📚 深度解析：计算声强级: 📚 Deep Dive: Computing the sound intensity level
map.由声强 I 求声强级 L_I=10·log10(I/I0)，I0=10⁻¹² W: From intensity I the level L_I=10·log10(I/I0) with I0=10^-12 W/m2.
map.把实测声强换算成对数刻度做噪声评价。: Convert measured intensity to a logarithmic scale for noise assessment.
map.互为校验（自由场中两者相等）。: serves as a cross-check (the two are equal in a free field).
map.某处声强 I=10⁻⁶ W/m²，I0=10⁻¹² W/m²，L_I=10·lo: At intensity I=10^-6 W/m2 with I0=10^-12 W/m2, L_I=10·log10(10^6)=60 dB.
map.声强级和声压级有什么区别？: What is the difference between intensity level and sound pressure level?
map.声强级由声强定义，声压级由声压定义；自由场且平面波时二者数值相等。: Intensity level is defined from intensity, sound pressure level from pressure; in a free field with plane waves the two are numerically equal.
map.这是人耳在 1 kHz 附近可听阈的近似声强，被定为声强级基准。: It approximates the human hearing threshold near 1 kHz and is adopted as the reference intensity.
map.如何使用由声强求声强级（I₀=10⁻¹² W/m²）: How to use Intensity level from sound intensity (I0=10^-12 W/m2)
map.表示声音相对于基准声强 I₀=10⁻¹² W/m² 的强度，以分贝（dB）对数刻: expresses a sound's intensity relative to the reference I0=10^-12 W/m2 on a logarithmic decibel (dB) scale; the larger the value, the stronger the sound.
map.单位 dB（分贝，无量纲对数比）。日常参考：0 dB 听觉阈值、40 dB 正常: Unit dB (decibel, a dimensionless logarithmic ratio). Everyday reference: 0 dB hearing threshold, 40 dB normal conversation, 70 dB vacuum cleaner, above 85 dB prolonged exposure risks hearing damage, 120 dB pain threshold.
map.=10·log₁₀(I/I₀) 适用于点声源自由场近似；实际声压级还受距离平方反: =10·log10(I/I0) applies under the point-source free-field approximation; actual sound pressure level is also affected by the inverse-square law, environmental reflection and frequency weighting (A-weighting). This tool uses an ideal model, for quick estimates only.
